TEJAX KART / PLAYER HANDBOOK

Your game.
Your device.

TEJAX KART stores game preferences and career totals in your browser. The game code does not include advertising trackers, analytics scripts, account registration or cloud saves.

Browser storage

Local storage saves career scores, settings and paint choices. The service worker saves game files in the browser cache for offline solo play. Clearing this website’s browser data removes these files and your local progress. Removing a home-screen icon may not remove all browser data.

Motion sensors

Tilt steering reads device orientation only after you enable it. Readings are processed in the game on your device and are not sent to the website or multiplayer server. Disable tilt in Settings to stop listening for motion readings.

Optional multiplayer

If you connect to a LAN or custom server, your chosen driver name, vehicle, paint, movement and gameplay actions are shared with that server and other players in the room. The server sees normal network connection information. Use a nickname and a server you trust. The included server keeps rooms in memory rather than storing player accounts.

Hosting

Visiting the website sends normal web requests to the hosting provider. The hosting platform may process IP addresses, browser information and request logs under its own policies. This page describes the game’s code; it does not replace the hosting provider’s privacy terms.

Manage or remove local data

Use your browser’s site settings to clear stored data for this website, remove motion permissions, or uninstall the web app. This also removes locally saved scores and settings. No account deletion request is needed because the game has no accounts.
